text_en: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple telling the seven angels, “Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God. ”
text_cn: 我听见由殿里发出一个大声音，向那七位天使说：“你们去，把那满盛天主义怒的七个盂（yú）倒在地上！”

text_en: So the first angel went and poured his bowl on the earth, and a foul and painful sore came on those who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped its image.
text_cn: 第一位天使便去，把他的盂倒在地上，遂在那些带有兽印和朝拜兽像的人身上，生出了一种恶毒而剧痛的疮。

text_en: The second angel poured his bowl into the sea, and it became like the blood of a corpse, and every living thing in the sea died.
text_cn: 第二位天使把他的盂倒在海里，海水就变成好似死人的血，因而海中的一切活物都死了。

text_en: The third angel poured his bowl into the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.
text_cn: 第三位天使把他的盂倒在河流和水泉上，水就变成了血。

text_en: And I heard the angel of the waters say, “You are just, O Holy One, who are and were, for you have judged these things;
text_cn: 那时，我听见掌管水的天使说：“今在和昔在的圣善者，你这样惩罚，真是公义，

text_en: because they shed the blood of saints and prophets, you have given them blood to drink. It is what they deserve! ”
text_cn: 因为他们曾倾流了圣徒和先知们的血，你如今给他们血喝，这是他们应得的。”

text_en: And I heard the altar respond, “Yes, O Lord God, the Almighty, your judgments are true and just! ”
text_cn: 我又听见从祭坛有声音说：“是的，上主，全能的天主！你的惩罚，真实而公义。”

text_en: The fourth angel poured his bowl on the sun, and it was allowed to scorch people with fire;
text_cn: 第四位天使把他的盂倒在太阳上，致使太阳以烈火炙烤世人。

text_en: they were scorched by the fierce heat, but they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues, and they did not repent and give him glory.
text_cn: 世人因被剧热所炙烤，便亵渎掌管这些灾祸的天主的名号，没有悔改将光荣归于天主。

text_en: The fifth angel poured his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness; people gnawed their tongues in agony,
text_cn: 第五位天使把他的盂倒在那兽座上，它的王国就陷入黑暗，人痛苦的咬自己的舌头；

text_en: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and sores, and they did not repent of their deeds.
text_cn: 他们因自己的痛苦和疮痍，便亵渎天上的天主，没有悔改自己的行为。

text_en: The sixth angel poured his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up in order to prepare the way for the kings from the east.
text_cn: 第六位天使把他的盂倒在幼发拉的大河中，河水就干涸了，为给那些由日出之地要来的诸王，准备了一条道路。

text_en: And I saw three foul spirits like frogs coming from the mouth of the dragon, from the mouth of the beast, and from the mouth of the false prophet.
text_cn: 我又看见从龙口、兽口和假先知口中出来了三个不洁的神，状如青蛙；

text_en: These are demonic spirits, performing signs, who go abroad to the kings of the whole world, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
text_cn: 他们是邪魔之神，施行奇迹，往全世界的诸王那里去，召集他们，为在全能天主的那伟大日子上交战。

text_en: (“See, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and is clothed, not going about naked and exposed to shame. ”)
text_cn: “看，我来有如盗贼一样；那醒着并保持自己的衣服，不至于赤身行走，而叫人看见自己的耻辱的，才是有福的！”

text_en: And they assembled them at the place that in Hebrew is called Harmagedon.
text_cn: 那三个神就把诸王聚集到一个地方，那地方希伯来文叫“阿玛革冬”。

text_en: The seventh angel poured his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple, from the throne, saying, “It is done! ”
text_cn: 第七位天使把他的盂倒在空气中，于是就由【天上的】殿里，从宝座那里发出了一个巨大声音说：“成了！”

text_en: And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, and a violent earthquake, such as had not occurred since people were upon the earth, so violent was that earthquake.
text_cn: 遂有闪电、响声和雷霆，又发生了大地震，是自从在地上有人类以来，从未有过这样大的地震。

text_en: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. God remembered great Babylon and gave her the wine-cup of the fury of his wrath.
text_cn: 那大城分裂为三段，异民的城也都倾覆了；天主想起了那伟大的巴比伦，遂递给她那盛满天主烈怒的酒杯。

text_en: And every island fled away, and no mountains were to be found;
text_cn: 各岛屿都消失了，诸山岭也不见了。

text_en: and huge hailstones, each weighing about a hundred pounds, dropped from heaven on people, until they cursed God for the plague of the hail, so fearful was that plague.
text_cn: 又有像‘塔冷通’般的大冰雹，从天上落在世人的身上；世人因冰雹的灾祸便亵渎天主，因为那灾祸太惨重了。
